summary: Independent Q6 rebuild finds a real dual-language L4 LB core (Go apply/revision/rollout/control-stream plus C++ epoll proxy, eligibility, active probing, and checkpoint recovery) with genuine cross-component coupling. However, six Go packages (~540 LOC) are never imported by any binary or lab entrypoint, DrainManager is constructed but never invoked, and the mechanical environment LOC of 3015 clears the large_system_strict floor only by counting those orphans plus 24 near-clone node JSON files. Honest reachable substantive runtime/config is about 2200–2500 LOC—below the >=3000 floor—so PADDING_RISK is HIGH and PASS is blocked.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges reachability, material branching/state/error handling, subsystem diversity, cross-component interactions, removal impact, and padding. For large_system_strict, >=3000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient; Complexity Governor or authenticity-validator PASS is not a conclusion to copy.

Required method: identify entrypoints, trace module reachability, check for clones/wrappers/unreachable filler, identify partial-fix traps, run a ~25% removal test, and separate production logic from config-volume noise. large_system_strict PASS also forbids HIGH toy or padding risk.

Count only implementation that materially participates; do not satisfy scale with duplicated, dead, or unreachable modules or config-volume inflation. Raw LOC does not substitute for differentiated reachable modules and coupling.
Software/Systems Go+C++ load-balancer task; artifacts [/app/sovereign-lb]; separate verifier; agent timeout 7200; workdir /app. No LOC claim inside task.toml.
Binds profile=large_system_strict and claims substantive_runtime_loc=3015. Used only to bind the strict floor; creator production-grade claims were not treated as a Q6 conclusion.
Reports profile=large_system_strict and gate PASS with stateful_dataset_exemption. Treated as evidence of declared profile only, not as a production-logic verdict.
Mechanical environment substantive_loc=3015 (go 1434, cpp 568, hpp 335, py 265, json 397, Dockerfile 16). Used as an inventory baseline; not accepted as honest reachable depth.
Control-plane entrypoint opens api.Service, serves management HTTP and framed control TCP. Import closure is only sovereign-lb/internal/api.
Thin HTTP client for apply/status/nodes/audit/ready; no additional internal packages.
Builds only ./cmd/lb-control-plane, ./cmd/lbctl, and the C++ lb-dataplane target. Packages not imported by those cmds are never linked.

Apply path validates desired state, begins revision/idempotency authority, compiles and stores snapshots, starts rollout, dispatches prepare, commits response. Imports audit/metrics/model/nodes/revision/rollout/snapshot only.
Node sessions fence hello/prepared/active/rejected, record rollout quorum transitions, and dispatch activate. Real control-plane↔dataplane coupling.
Dataplane entrypoint loads node config, restores checkpoint, wires eligibility/health/drain/prober/proxy/status/control threads. All CMake sources are compiled into this binary.
Substantive epoll accept/connect/transfer/idle-timeout path with PROXY v2 header injection and eligibility-aware selection—non-toy dataplane core.
Zone-local preference, cross-zone policy, fail-open, and drain-deadline filtering are real branching used by Proxy::accept_client.
Active TCP probe loop with thresholds feeding HealthTracker; reachable from main probe thread.
Digest-checked generation directories, CURRENT pointer, and corrupt-CURRENT fallback load—real restart recovery on dataplane.
Implements prepare/activate/status/reject over framed control. ControlClient stores DrainManager& drains_ but never calls transition/collect—drain object is wired dead.
117 non-comment LOC for CURRENT recovery and authority validation. No Go import of sovereign-lb/internal/recovery exists under environment/.
98 LOC generation lease/GC manager. Unreferenced by api, cmds, or lab tools.
70 LOC readiness evaluator. Service.handleReady uses an inline repository/revision check instead; package is orphaned.
62 LOC scenario loader/writer. Never imported; lab/scenario JSON is consumed elsewhere without this package.
Together with inventory.go (~163 LOC), Go fleet helpers are orphaned; tools/lab/fleet_simulator.py reimplements inventory loading in Python.
~30 LOC control-plane health aggregator. Architecture docs claim health aggregation on the control plane, but no import reaches this package.
Representative of 24 nearly identical 11-line node profiles differing mainly by id/session/state_root/status/zone. Mechanically adds ~264 LOC toward the 3015 count.
Loopback lab backends (echo/slow/half-close/reset/proxy-v2) are reachable via bin/lab and exercise dataplane stream behaviors.
Documents operator workflow: build, lb-control-plane, lb-dataplane --config, lbctl, lab. Confirms intended entrypoints used in the reachability walk.

findings.criterion: major modules must be reachable from real entrypoints/operator workflows
findings.why_it_matters: recovery, retention, readiness, catalog, fleet, and health (~540 non-comment LOC) never enter any binary or lab import graph, so they inflate module count and mechanical LOC without production behavior.
findings.minimal_remediation: Wire each package into lb-control-plane/lbctl/lab operator paths with observable state effects, or delete them and replace the lost depth with reachable domain logic.
findings.regression_risk: Wiring may change readiness/recovery/retention semantics that solvers and tests assume; delete-only shrinks the environment and may drop below the floor further.

findings.criterion: large_system_strict requires >=3000 substantive reachable solver-visible runtime/config LOC
findings.why_it_matters: Mechanical 3015 includes ~540 orphan Go LOC and ~253 redundant near-clone node JSON lines beyond one template. Honest reachable substantive runtime/config is about 2200–2500, below the strict floor.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add reachable production logic (or fully wire orphans with real call sites) until honest reachable LOC clears 3000 without counting dead packages or duplicated inventory shells.
findings.regression_risk: Expanding LOC without coupling risks more padding; must grow behavior that entrypoints actually execute.

findings.criterion: compiled modules must participate in runtime behavior, not constant-output or dead shells
findings.why_it_matters: DrainManager is constructed and injected into ControlClient but transition/collect are never called, so generation-retirement drain behavior is absent despite appearing as a major dataplane module.
findings.minimal_remediation: Invoke DrainManager::transition on activate/runtime swap and collect on a tick, or remove the unused drain surface from the claimed core.
findings.regression_risk: Enabling drain transitions changes eligibility during rollouts and may alter stream teardown timing.

findings.criterion: separate production complexity from config-volume noise and duplicated resources
findings.why_it_matters: Twenty-four near-identical node profiles contribute ~264 mechanical LOC. Fleet inventory is operationally meaningful, but counting template clones as substantive implementation depth is padding toward the floor.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep a compact inventory generator or shared defaults plus per-node deltas; do not rely on clone volume for the substantive LOC floor.
findings.regression_risk: Collapsing node files requires updating lab/fleet paths that expect per-node JSON.

change_scope: Wire or remove orphan Go packages (recovery, retention, readiness, catalog, fleet, health) so declared modules are entrypoint-reachable
Invoke dataplane DrainManager on activate/runtime transitions or drop the dead drain surface
Grow honest reachable runtime/config logic until substantive LOC clears 3000 without orphan/clone inflation
Re-run Q6 after production-scope environment changes
do_not_change: Do not treat Complexity Governor or runtime-authenticity PASS as a substitute for reachable depth
Do not inflate LOC with more unwired packages, duplicated thick templates, or vendor trees
Do not weaken the real coupled core (revision/rollout/control-stream, epoll proxy, eligibility, probing, checkpoints)
next_gate: Environment Builder / System Architect: eliminate unreachable padding and raise honest reachable substantive LOC above 3000, then re-request Q6

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Mechanical environment inventory (validate_task_complexity) is 3015 non-blank non-comment lines across go/cpp/hpp/py/json/Dockerfile. Independent reachability walk finds ~540 LOC in never-imported Go packages (recovery 117, retention 98, readiness 70, catalog 62, fleet 163, health ~30) and ~253 LOC of near-clone node JSON beyond one 11-line template. DrainManager (~38 cpp + header) is constructed but never invoked. Honest substantive reachable runtime/config is approximately 2200–2500 LOC (reachable Go import closure ~900, all compiled dataplane cpp/hpp ~900, lab py ~265, unique desired/fleet/scenario config ~133, plus modest consumed node/profile variance). That is below the large_system_strict >=3000 floor. Creator claim of 3015 was not accepted as honest reachable depth.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing only apply/revision without rollout quorum + session fencing leaves prepare/activate stuck
Fixing proxy forwarding without eligibility/health/probe coupling breaks fail-open and unhealthy ejection
Fixing dataplane checkpoint load without control-plane CURRENT/generation store leaves restart asymmetry
Wiring readiness package without replacing inline /ready can fork two readiness truths
Enabling DrainManager without activate-path transition can leave draining targets still selected
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the reachable core would collapse claimed behavior: deleting proxy transfer/eligibility selection removes L4 service; deleting control-stream prepare/activate removes publication; deleting revision/snapshot removes authority and digests; deleting prober/health removes active eligibility dynamics; deleting checkpoint remove restart continuity. Separately, deleting the orphan Go packages and unused drain methods would not change current operator-visible runtime behavior—evidence they are padding relative to today's entrypoints.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Make recovery/retention/readiness/catalog/fleet/health reachable from lb-control-plane, lbctl, or lab with observable effects, or remove them
Call DrainManager::transition/collect from activate/runtime publish paths (or remove dead drain API)
Increase honest reachable substantive runtime/config LOC to >=3000 without orphan packages or duplicated node-JSON inflation
Re-audit Q6 after environment production-scope edits
